title: Towing and Labor Coverage Underwriting Guide: Attaching Coverage, Vehicle Age and Effective Dates
content:
## 1. Owner term status

Towing coverage is added only to a vehicle of an owner term whose status is bound or in force. The vehicle must be scheduled on that owner term. The status is taken from the company's record of the owner term to which the coverage is being attached, as it stands before the coverage is added; an owner term in any other status does not take **Towing and Labor Coverage**.

| Status of the owner term the coverage attaches to | Coverage may be added |
|---|---|
| Bound | Yes |
| In force | Yes |
| Any other status | No |

## 2. Vehicle age

The vehicle's model year must be within the package's vehicle age limit. The limit is stated in model years before the current model year and marks the oldest vehicle eligible.

| Package | Oldest vehicle eligible (model years before the current model year) |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $50 | 30 |
| Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $75 | 30 |
| Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $100 | 25 |
| Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $125 | 25 |
| Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $150 | 20 |
| Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $200 | 20 |

*Hypothetical boundary:* if the current model year were 2026, the oldest vehicle eligible for the Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $150 package would be a 2006 model; a 2006 model qualifies and a 2005 model does not. For the Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $50 package the same year would admit a 1996 model but not a 1995 model.

## 3. Physical damage coverage

Physical damage coverage is not required on the vehicle for any package; Towing and Labor Coverage may be added to a vehicle with or without it.

## 4. Effective date when added

The coverage is added effective the date requested, never earlier, and starts on its effective date. Until that date it is scheduled; on that date it becomes active. This applies when the coverage is added mid-term as well.

*Hypothetical:* a coverage requested to begin on the 15th of a month takes effect on the 15th, not on any earlier day, and remains scheduled until then.

## 5. Package change

A change from one Cardinal Point Towing and Labor package to another takes effect on the date requested.

## Quick reference across packages

| Item | $50 | $75 | $100 | $125 | $150 | $200 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Oldest vehicle eligible (model years) | 30 | 30 | 25 | 25 | 20 | 20 |
| Physical damage coverage required | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Effective date when added | Date requested, never earlier | Date requested, never earlier | Date requested, never earlier | Date requested, never earlier | Date requested, never earlier | Date requested, never earlier |
